params.prompt:
Production PIXEL ART fighting-game assist animation sheet, EXACTLY 32 complete drawings in an exact FOUR-COLUMN by EIGHT-ROW grid. Every row has FOUR actors. Same ONE cartoon character throughout, facing RIGHT, same head/body proportions and scale. Hard stepped pixels, dark outlines, compact palette; no smooth vector edges. Entire body/hands/feet fit inside each cell with wide empty margins. Pure MAGENTA #ff00ff background, no grid, labels, text, effects, opponents or extra subjects.
IDENTITY: Copy the attached combat sprite EXACTLY: pale LAVENDER swept pointed spiky head and lavender torso, TWO narrow sleepy YELLOW eyes with black pupils, wide closed RED lips, dark neck band, YELLOW hands and YELLOW feet with RED shoes. Small smoking accessory remains attached to one hand when feasible. Smooth opaque purple covered lower torso/pelvis, no visible anatomy detail. Same cartoon design and proportions throughout. No new hat or coat. Exactly two arms and two low-rooted legs. The engine adds a comic yellow stream effect; do NOT draw liquid or particles.
The new assist sequence needs a confident run-in, planted low-hand attack poses and a quick retreat. All low-hand attack poses keep the low torso completely covered and the mouth CLOSED. Hands are held in front of the covered low pelvis, torso leans back and feet stay firmly planted; never point the mouth or palm to cast.
Row 1 ENTER 0-3: low forward lean; rear leg pushes into a quick step; traveling stride; front foot plants and brakes.
Row 2 ENTER 4-5 and ATTACK 0-1: upright settling with hands lowering; planted upright ready stance; knees coil with hands at covered low pelvis; lean torso back, covered pelvis angles forward, both feet planted.
Row 3 ATTACK 2-5: sustain low-hand forward pelvic stance; slightly relax while hands remain low; wider planted recoil coil; stronger lean-back forward pelvic stance.
Row 4 ATTACK 6-9: sustained low-hand attack stance; ease stance without lifting hands; alternate knee weight shift with hands low; emphatic forward pelvic pose, torso leans back and mouth closed.
Row 5 ATTACK 10-13: hold third planted attack; lower stance in recovery; finish windup with feet widest and hands low; strongest final forward pelvic stance, clear continuous low hips and planted feet.
Row 6 ATTACK 14-15 and EXIT 0-1: sustain final low-hand stance; relax and lift hands toward guard; rearward weight shift; first quick backward step.
Row 7 EXIT 2-5: backpedal with guard raised; airborne short backward hop with knees bent; land behind on rear foot; settled relaxed guard.
Row 8 VICTORY 0-3: cheeky upright grin, lips still closed; one fist raised confidently; small jaunty two-finger salute; composed upright guard. All limbs attached, complete feet in every drawing. Exactly 32 actors, four per row.
